title: Happy path
description: Clean text PDF, PO quoted, three itemised lines, CGST and SGST. Everything matches.

title: Scanned invoice, clean
description: A tilted, noisy scan with no text layer. OCR reads it, arithmetic confirms the read, and it posts untouched.

title: Monthly service instalment
description: Instalment 8 of 12 against a Rs 7,20,000 service PO. A partial bill that fits the balance is normal.

title: E1 Split PO, third invoice over-bills
description: PO for 20 units and Rs 5,00,000. Two invoices already posted for 16 units. This one bills 5 more.

title: E2 Disguised duplicate
description: Same vendor, lines and amount as an invoice posted two days earlier, under a new invoice number.

title: E3 Scan, no invoice number, PO implied
description: Scanned bill with the number left blank and no PO quoted. The PO is inferred and a person is asked to confirm.

title: E4 Tax-inclusive prices, inside tolerance
description: Prices include GST; the PO is pre-tax. After conversion one price is Rs 3.39 over, inside both limits.

title: E4 Tax-inclusive prices, outside tolerance
description: Same vendor and item; after conversion the price is Rs 50 over (1.56%), outside the 1% limit.

title: Fraud guard: bank account changed
description: A perfect match on the PO, but the bank account differs from the vendor master and the name is a variant.

title: AI assist: invoice written as a letter
description: Free-form prose, no table. Rules alone hold it. With LLM assist on, the lines are read and verified against the page.

title: Quotation sent to the invoice inbox
description: A quotation in an invoice-like layout. Nothing is payable.

title: Unrelated PDF
description: A staff bulletin. No invoice fields at all.

title: Corrupt file
description: Starts like a PDF, then random bytes.
